title: Where did my file go?
summary: Use File Explorer to find and open files.

documents.name: my letter.docx
documents.content: Dear family, I am learning to use my computer.

steps.hint: The blue Windows logo at the bottom.

steps.detail: File Explorer shows everything saved on your computer.
This is where your saved files usually live.

steps.say: Double-click my letter to open it.
Click the X to close Word.
steps.detail: You found your file. Nothing is lost.
